rationale: Trimming 12 percent of the spot core to rebuild ammunition, because the condition that capped morning's add did not improve - it got worse, and the structure that justified holding broke. Morning's reduce level at 79,185.0 fired on the settled 15:00 UTC close of 78,834.1 and its 79,000.0 invalidation was breached by 318 points on a 78,682.0 low. Price at 79,180.7 now sits below all four hourly EMAs for the first time this decline, including the 1H EMA200 at 79,311.17 that morning named as the last one holding. The day has a complete lower-high-lower-low sequence on the hourly: 79,648.1 against 79,927.3, and 78,682.0 against 79,000.0. Meanwhile open interest rose 2.60 percent from 2,131,493,483 to 2,186,965,596 USD while price fell 293.2 points, and the OKX 1H long/short account ratio climbed from 1.11 to 1.17 - straight through a second seven-figure long flush, 1,086,427 USD across 89 fills at the 78,750 bucket, on top of the 1,220,668 USD flushed at 79,000 this morning. Roughly 2.3 million dollars of long leverage has been forcibly closed today and the book is more long than before it started. When leverage rebuilds long through its own liquidation, the next flush usually comes from lower. The wallet was 95 percent deployed in spot with 9.72 USDT of cash, which is no ammunition at all for the 78,682 and 78,650 shelf where the extreme magnet sits. A 12 percent trim near flat on a 78,597.22 average entry converts a little exposure into about 23 USDT of dry powder without abandoning the position. It stays a trim rather than an exit because the daily is untouched: price is above all four daily EMAs, 2,429.9 points over the EMA20 at 76,750.62, with daily RSI at 62.94, ETF flows on a 3-day inflow streak and DXY down 0.27 percent to 98.878. No futures either way. Long is wrong under four hourly EMAs with the 1H MACD histogram still widening at -53.35; short is wrong 498 points above a pocket that has just been flushed, with the 15m already reclaiming its EMA20 and building three higher lows.

message.text: Watch the 4H EMA50 at 79,056.90 - it is 123.8 points under spot and it is the pivot that separates a pullback from a trend change. A settled 4H close beneath it puts the next structural reference at the EMA100, some 1,848 points lower. I left about 33 USDT of cash for you. The 78,682 low and the 78,650 shelf from 04 September are where I want it spent, not up here. Also check whether the overnight gap needs a resting stop: the ETF channel stays shut until Tuesday, so leverage is still the only voter.

lesson.pattern: Open interest rising while price falls, with the long/short account ratio climbing straight through a large long liquidation event
lesson.insight: A flush only clears the book if the book stays cleared. Twice today BTC liquidated over a million dollars of longs and twice open interest came out higher than it went in, with the account ratio walking 1.11 to 1.17. That is replacement, not capitulation, and it means the fuel for the next move down was rebuilt at a worse price. Treat a flush that open interest rises through as a warning rather than a bottom.
